SELECT c.*, g.good_name, g.image, u.nickname FROM store_good_comment c LEFT JOIN store_good g ON c.good_id = g.good_id LEFT JOIN store_user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.is_show = 1
AND g.good_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.goodName}, '%')
AND u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.nickname}, '%')
AND c.reply_content IS NOT NULL AND c.reply_content != ''
AND (c.reply_content IS NULL OR c.reply_content = '')
ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
